A [[Ryn/Legends|Ryn]] was the '''mate''' of [[Piani]], with whom he had a [[Piani's son|son]]. During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], he was unable to reach [[Gyndine/Legends|Gyndine's]] capital [[City/Legends|city]] in time to board an evacuation [[Starship/Legends|ship]] and,<ref name="BP" /> by [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The New Jedi Order: Balance Point]]'' to [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]].</ref> was presumed by Piani to be [[Death/Legends|dead]] or worse.<ref name="BP" />
